title: Villarroel approached by people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds

tellings.quote: I have been approached by some people I suspect have it.

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel studies strange short-lived points of light on old photographs of the sky, which she suggests could be objects near Earth. She says that in 2025, in Stockholm, she was approached by people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds. She tells Michels this herself, saying only "I have been approached by some people I suspect have it," and if her suspicion is right, spy agencies are quietly interested in her work.
